dialog.body: Public Works, this is Kevin.
Hello, Kevin. Yes, this is Conceicao Vieira. I'm calling about the drain at the corner by my place. It's been backed up since last Thursday and nobody has come.
Okay, sorry to hear that. Let me grab a pen. Where are you located, Mrs. Vieira?

58 Pelham Street, up on the Hill. The catch basin is right on the corner there. It's full of leaves, packed, and there's a puddle sitting in front of it that never goes down. And it hasn't even rained.
So no storm, just dry weather and the water's not going anywhere. Catch basin, corner of Pelham, clogged with leaves since Thursday. Got it.

Yes. And the sidewalk, oh, it's a sheet of mud and grit. Everything that washes down the hill ends up there. People walk through it and track it right into my shop. I'm cleaning that floor twice a day.
Ah, you've got a shop there. That's got to be a pain.

I do, I've had it a long time. Oh, and by the way, I just found out they're letting the schools out early tomorrow. Early dismissal. Nobody told me until this morning, so now I have to rearrange my whole afternoon. Anyway. The drain.
Yeah, that's a surprise for a lot of folks. Okay, back to the drain. Is the puddle out in the street or up on the sidewalk?

Both. It starts in the street by the grate and spreads over to the curb and the sidewalk. When a car goes by it splashes everybody. I called once already, you know, last week. Or I meant to. Well, I'm calling now.

No problem, I'll put it in now. I'm writing it up as a clogged catch basin, leaf debris, standing water and silt on the sidewalk. Does it smell or is there anything else in it, trash, anything like that?

Just leaves, wet leaves, and some bottles and a bag stuck in there. It's not a smell, it's just a mess. Oh, and the other thing, there's another one down the block toward the water that does the same thing, but that one's not my problem. I only mean mine.
Okay, if you want, give me the cross street for the other one and I can note it too.
I don't know the cross street. Forget it. It's not mine. I just want mine cleaned out. It's been almost a week, Kevin.
Understood. I'll flag that one as the corner right at 58 Pelham. Can I get a callback number in case the crew needs to reach you?
Sure. It's 401-555-0158. That's my cell, so if it cuts out, call back. The reception on the Hill is terrible sometimes.
Four oh one, five five five, oh one five eight. Right?
That's right.
Great. So it goes to the crew that handles the drains. They go out in order of what's been reported, and a clogged basin with standing water is something they'll want to get to.
When, though? That's what I want to know. Do the crews work on weekends? Because if it sits until Saturday I'm going to be out there with a shovel myself, and I'm too old for that.

Please don't go out there with a shovel near the street. As for weekends, they're mostly weekday, so I'd expect it to get looked at this week, probably the next day or two. Weekends tend to be for emergencies.

Well, this is an emergency for my floor. Oh, never mind. I'm not trying to yell at you. It's just that it keeps happening every fall with those leaves, and nobody ever comes until I call, and then I call again.
I hear you. I'll put a note that it's a repeat spot with leaves so they know to bring the right equipment. That helps.
Good. Please do that. And the mud on the sidewalk, will they clean that too, or is that mine?
Usually they clear the basin and rake out what's around it. If there's a lot of silt left on the sidewalk, I'll note that too and they can see when they get there.
Okay. Because somebody's going to slip. [pause] Somebody's going to come in with a coat full of mud and slip on my tile.
Yeah, that's a fair point. I'm adding the slipping concern to the note. Anything else at that corner, any broken grate, or sinking pavement?
No, the grate is fine. It's only the leaves. Just get somebody out there before it freezes. If that water freezes it's an ice rink in front of my door.
Good thinking, I'll mention the freezing too. Okay, you're all set, Mrs. Vieira. Request is in for 58 Pelham Street, and if the line drops they've got your number.
Thank you, Kevin. I hope it's soon. I'll look out the window tomorrow.
Sounds good. Take care, and good luck with the early dismissal.
Yes, yes, I'll need it. Goodbye.
